classification: Static byte-anchored composition with caller-supplied snapshots; not an original execution or complete reconstruction.

composition_ledger.claim: The caller has already resolved N and derived-branch, marker seed, BL and XMM3 (0/1) observations. Full upstream seed production and guards remain outside this API.
Only a derived branch with ordered nonzero marker seed executes the two helpers. Direct/zero/unordered paths reuse the existing producer without fallback observations.
Current values are the previous N+50 and N+54 float words. Targets are mode_byte==8 ? 1 : 0 and the separately resolved XMM3 seed. They are not reversed.
Calls are ordered +50 at 0x414f8753, then +54 at 0x414f877a. Divisors are bits 0x3e800000/0x3ccccccd, bounds 0/1, tolerance 0x3c23d70a and requested step -1.
Each helper receives its own optional fallback snapshot; equality/unordered bypasses fallback. A shared source address does not establish temporal value equality.
Successful helper outputs feed MarkerSideValues into produce_resolved_validity_marker. Its original multiplication order is unchanged; only N+48/+50/+54 may change.

Missing actually required fallback returns a side-specific unresolved outcome, without committing any N bytes. This transactional no-change rule is an offline API convention, not inferred original rollback; the original first helper can already have written N before the second call.
support: GAP04 scalar_helper stores and ordered marker calls

proof_boundaries: Raw address base 0x412a0000 is a file-coordinate convention, not an observed runtime mapping.
Input snapshots must be resolved by the caller. No discovery, implicit global reads, provider owner identity, full reachability or alias-based observation inference.
Requires binary32, round-to-nearest, no fast-math/FP contraction, FTZ/DAZ or signaling NaNs. FP exception flags/traps and original ABI are not modeled.
No original image loading, execution/emulation, game connection, injection, sender or target selection.
Native/sanitized tests execute only the authored offline C++ model. No full equivalence, GAP04/GAP05 closure or independent review is claimed.
